hints.title: Number of Unique Binary Codes
hints.text: There are 2^k distinct binary codes of length k. Check if the string length is at least 2^k + k - 1.

hints.title: Collect Substrings of Length k
hints.text: Extract all substrings of length k from s and insert them into a unique collection.

hints.title: Verify Collection Size
hints.text: If the number of unique substrings equals 2^k, return true. Early exit if collection size reaches 2^k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^k codes and searching for each in s takes O(2^k * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single sliding pass inserts substrings into a set, testing set size == 1 << k.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate extracts all k-length substrings and checks if unique count reaches 1 << k.
